from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper in the collection: its title and which other provided papers it cites."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this specific paper")
    cites_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="List of titles of OTHER provided papers that are referenced in this paper's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
